annotations.title: Native and USDC balances on 5 networks

description: Read a wallet's native coin and USDC balances on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism and Polygon in one call, live from each network, plus the USDC total. Use to find where a wallet's funds are before a payment or bridge; for one token on one network use <chain>_token_balance, for all tokens on Base use wallet_portfolio. A network whose nodes do not answer is listed with an error instead of failing the call. Example: address=0xd8dA6BF26964aF9D7eEd9e03E53415D37aA96045. Price $0.005/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
